verses.1: And this is the blessing that Moses, the man of God, blessed upon the children of Israel before their death.
verses.2: And the LORD said from His heaven: “Come! Let fire appear before Him. It will shine from the mountain Paran. And from His right hand, a fire of holiness will be sent forth.”
verses.3: Even the gods of other nations will be in your hands. They will bow down before you, and they will obey your commands.
verses.4: The Torah commands us by Moses, from the lineage of Jacob.
verses.5: And it happened that in Bithron, the king gathered together the leaders of the people, all the rulers of Israel.
verses.6: May Reuben and Al-Yamot live on, and may their deaths be recorded as part of history.
verses.7: And this is for Judah. He said, “Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah! And bring us out from its troubles.” May his hands be strong, and may he receive help from his enemies.
verses.8: And he said to them, “You shall be blessed and honored by your faithful friend, who has tried to help you in times of difficulty.”
verses.9: He did not see his father and mother. He did not know his brothers, nor did he know about his children. But they kept your words and vows, and they will be blessed according to your covenant.
verses.10: May your laws be fulfilled for Jacob, and your Torah for Israel. May they bring destruction upon you, and may they destroy all your idols.
verses.11: May the LORD bless his army, and may his hands accomplish what he desires. May those who oppose him be destroyed from among those who rise up against him.
verses.12: To Lavanim, the friend of Jehovah said, “May he rest in peace. May all days be peaceful for him. And among his descendants, may they also rest in peace.”
verses.13: And Josue said, “May the LORD bless this land from above the heavens. May it be fertile and abundant with crops.”
verses.14: And from the rising of the sun, and from the setting of the moon.
verses.15: And from the top of the ancient mountains, and from the depths of the valleys of eternity.
verses.16: And from the land itself, and from its fullness, will come my desire. It will be brought to the head of Joseph, and to the place where his brothers live.
verses.17: In the valley of Shooro, there was a river. The branches of its trees were intertwined with those of other rivers. People from various lands gathered together there. They were like clouds of eagles, and they numbered in the thousands.
verses.18: And Zebulon said, “Rejoice, Zebulon, as you leave here. May you be rewarded in your own home.”
verses.19: The nations of the hill called out that they would worship the gods of righteousness. For their waters have become bitter, and their springs have become foul and unclean.
verses.20: And Elgad said, “Blessed is he who expands his heart like a dog that hunts and eats insects.”
verses.21: And he saw that there was a part of the land that belonged to Sefon. And the leaders of the people of God made laws and judgments for Israel.
verses.22: And Eldan said, “Dan Gur, the lion, will be brought down from the sky.”
verses.23: And Naphtali said, “Naphtali is filled with the desires of God. The sea and its waters are filled with the blessings of Jehovah.”
verses.24: And when he said, “Blessed are those who are worthy of being his brothers,” he also said that his feet should be bathed in oil.
verses.25: Iron and nails from your shoes, and also those days when you were born.
verses.26: There is no one who can ride on the clouds with your help, and in his glory, he can play games.
verses.27: May the God of oldness and eternity be exalted from beneath the roots of time. May He drive away those who are evil from before you. And may He say, “May it be destroyed!”
verses.28: And Israel shall dwell in safety alone, near the place where Jacob lies. They shall inherit the land of Daggan. But their faces will be covered with dust.
verses.29: For you, Israel, there is no one like you among the people who are righteous in the LORD. He will be your shield and protection against those who harm you. He will also see your faults and weaknesses. But you, on the other hand, will remain strong and unshaken.
